nodeGroups.name: Price and validate order
nodeGroups.description: Shapes the incoming order, prices it via the order.process sub-workflow, then checks whether it is valid

nodeGroups.name: Create CRM sales order
nodeGroups.description: For valid orders: matches SKUs to CRM products, creates the sales order, and checks the CRM accepted it

nodeGroups.name: Confirm accepted order
nodeGroups.description: For valid orders: builds the student roster file and returns a 201 confirmation to the caller

nodeGroups.name: Charge card on file
nodeGroups.description: After the held sales order exists: charges the saved card, marks the order paid, or returns 402 and leaves it on hold
